on the floor and push the shelf to find an An Aid, here there are six panels that control the gas pipes, they are arranged more or less like this: 1 2 3 4 5 6

You must connect the tubes of the same color so choose the options as follows, in this order: 5=RED, 3=GREEN, 1=BLUE, 2=RED, 4=GREEN, 6=BLUE, this will activate the large elevator, go there and touch the control panel, talk to Rick and he will help Tom get there, when you get down there, the path will be blocked by containers, go up the ladder and push the shelf to get an An Aid, go to a control panel and use the B1 Crane Key on it, the arrows indicate how many times the crane will move, you can move it, twice to the right and once to the left, twice up and once down

, HOOK is for pick up a container and RELEASE is used to release it, choose the directions in which you will move the crane, choose HOOK then click on START, then choose the direction where you will release the container, choose RELEASE and click on START, when you can open the way , click EXIT and go to the double doors.
